title: More ways to make media
summary:
A community-focused day brought five apps into the catalog and repaired links to several more.

The app catalog added Nexus AI for creating images, video, and audio, alongside a community-built AI Image Generator that uses keys supplied by its users.

MonaChat.jp joined the catalog with Japanese character chat, ASCII art interactions, and Pollinations-powered image sharing. Architecture-updated-, a web-based AI chat app, joined it.

The catalog added AI router, an app for routing requests through other services, while a community contribution filled missing app links and corrected existing ones. A directory is more useful when its links go somewhere.
